content: Undweer a ngaŋ wanswà bàfun'wal uboo a baar, bàfun'sɔɔl ntɔn musyääl Nzam ntɔn ubwaŋ a baar. Isal ande kyà mupà an'kab anà ibɔɔn ntɔn man'be.
Ntɔn nde ŋakwo sye we anà gyɔ̈ɔ̈là asànaa baar banswà, lalan nde wàŋàkwo muyöb baar mpa bàfàyöb anà bàfàbwà ndwaŋ.
Ntɔn gyɔ̈ɔ̈là alà, nde akyer apà ibɔɔn kà nà ntɔn man'be a un'sɛŋ mpɛl anki, wɛɛ ntɔn mànde ŋakwo sye.
Yumwɛy, mbuur ufàpɛɛl anki isal aki nde ŋakwo, kya bàfàwal u mbwo a làbeel a Nzam, asànaa yàkäl ya akà Alɔn.
Kyakin, itàkal Klistɔ kàsàpɛɛl anki nde ŋakwo làkoo mubulà undweer a angaŋ. Nde la kàwɛl akà mbuur awà kàtɛn a nde naa:
Unsà mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande u mɛɛn, Yɛsu kàsi ngyamàkà anà ndɔ̈ɔ̈m, anà in'kwɛŋ anà nsaaŋ, akà mbuur kàkwe mukun'tswà mɔ̈ɔ̈ unsà ukwà, ntɔn ya Nzam kàkyer un'wem ntɔn unkyeey ande.
Itàkal naa nde kàkäl Mwan a Nzam, u mbwo a mpay kàmɛn nde, nde kàlɔŋàkà unkyeey.
Abun, nde kàkɔlà wàŋàkwo, waa kàbulà isin a ngweel a mɔ̈ɔ̈ ipepey ntɔn baar banswà bàfun'kyey.
Kyakin, Nzam kun'si nde undweer a angaŋ uboo a un'lwaŋ a Mɛlkisɛdɛk.
Unsà ndaa ayi, bi ibye anà indiir mbɔɔn mutɛn, wɛɛ yà mpay mubaal ya, ntɔn bɛ làkyàbulà anà undäär muyöb.
Sɛmà itaan, bɛ làlàkal alɔɔŋ, wɛɛ bɛ lan'fàkal anà ngyal naa bàlalɔŋ indiir atàtwɛb byà ndaa a Nzam. Bɛ làkyàkɔlà kà ikal mukal anà ngyal a bɛɛl, akwànaa isaa a bwoor.
Mbuur awà u mun a bɛɛl tii mpalàbà, ukwe anki mulab an'kyän unsà ndaa a balàbal, ntɔn nde wà mwan un'kye.
Wɛɛ isaa a bwoor byà ntɔn andweer. U nsyääl aba, ba bàkyàsà nsɔ̈ɔ̈l aba unsà yàŋàbwaŋ anà yàmbe.
